content: Customer Ananya Nair contacted insurance agent Sunita Agarwal regarding her health policy (HP-123456) which expired on the 10th due to non-payment, expressing concern over the lack of prior notification. The agent apologized for the oversight, confirmed the expiration reason, and provided an invoice with instructions to pay the outstanding premium and reinstatement fee to renew the policy.

action_items: Pay outstanding premium and reinstatement fee using the provided invoice
